messages.subject: Quote for the Q1 print run: 12,000 units
messages.preview: Hi Assem, as discussed, the unit price at 12,000 is 0.84 EUR, delivery in week 4. Please find the signed quote attached.
body: Hi Assem,
As discussed, the unit price at 12,000 is 0.84 EUR (10,080 EUR total, VAT excluded), delivery in week 4 to the Düsseldorf warehouse.
Please find the signed quote attached. Two options at the end: a 170 g cover (+0.06 EUR per unit) and a spot varnish on the cover (+0.03 EUR per unit).
Let me know by Tuesday so we can hold the press slot.
Best,
Karen Bosch, Linea Supply
quoted: Thanks Assem. Our estimator is on it; you will have the quote by Friday.

messages.subject: Final logo files + brand book v3

body: Hi Assem,
The brand book v3 is in the shared folder. The wordmark now has the tighter tracking you asked for, and the icon grid is on page 12.
I also exported the logo files as SVG and PNG at 1x, 2x and 3x.
Marie
quoted: Could you send the final files once the tracking is fixed?

messages.subject: Re: Clarification points, section 4.2
messages.preview: Thanks Assem. Two points remain open on the SLA table; can you confirm the penalty cap by Monday?

Two points remain open on the SLA table: the penalty cap and the response time for priority 2 tickets.
Can you confirm the penalty cap by Monday? We propose 10% of the monthly fee.
Tom
quoted: Here are our answers to the clarification points of section 4.2.
